items.explain: The two rooks share a file, so the extra character is the starting rank. R1h3 is the rook from h1; R5h3 would be the one from h5.

feedback_by_move.h5h3: That is R5h3, the other rook. The 1 in R1h3 names the starting rank.

items.explain: dxc6 is the en passant capture: the pawn lands on c6, an empty square, and the black pawn on c5 is removed.

items.prompt: White to move. The score says gxh8=N+. Play it.

claims.statement: A black rook stands on h8.

hints: =N says the pawn becomes a knight on arrival, and + says the move gives check.

items.explain: gxh8=N+ captures the rook and the pawn becomes a knight. From h8 the knight gives check to the king on g6. The same capture as =Q would be a different move.

feedback_by_move.g7h8q: That is gxh8=Q. The record says =N, so the pawn must become a knight.
